description: Structured eval definitions for the ElastiCache Cache Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across workload types (Redis cluster mode enabled, Redis cluster mode disabled session store, simple Memcached cache, Global Datastore cross-region) and missing-prerequisite branches. Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Production Redis cluster mode enabled with Multi-AZ + TLS + AUTH + CMK
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — all checklist items verified, cluster mode enabled + Multi-AZ + customer CMK + TLS + AUTH + allkeys-lru + snapshots
eval_cases.prompt: Provision a production ElastiCache Redis cluster named "prod-cache" in us-east-1. We need cluster mode enabled with 3 shards (1 replica per shard for Multi-AZ failover). Traffic is mixed read/write at ~80k writes/sec sustained. Use cache.r6g.2xlarge nodes. The cluster is a general-purpose cache (data is disposable). Use customer-managed CMK alias/prod-cache-kms for encryption at rest. Enable TLS and AUTH (token in Secrets Manager). Snapshots: 7-day retention, window 03:00-05:00 UTC. Subnet group prod-cache-subnet spans 3 AZs. Security group sg-cache123 has inbound 6379 from sg-app456. Tags: Environment=production, Workload=cache. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CACHE: prod-cache
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Engine: redis
  [✓] Cluster mode: ENABLED (3 shards)
  [✓] Node type: cache.r6g.2xlarge (62.34 GiB nominal; 31.17 GiB usable per shard; 93.51 GiB total usable)
  [✓] Replicas: 1 per shard (3 total) — Multi-AZ failover
  [✓] Multi-AZ with automatic failover: Enabled
  [✓] Subnet group: prod-cache-subnet (3 AZs)
  [✓] Security group: sg-cache123 (inbound 6379 from sg-app456)
  [✓] Encryption at rest: Enabled (customer CMK alias/prod-cache-kms)
  [✓] Encryption in transit (TLS): Enabled
  [✓] AUTH token: Enabled (stored in Secrets Manager)
  [✓] Parameter group: maxmemory-policy=allkeys-lru (cache semantics — disposable data)
  [✓] Snapshot retention: 7 days (window 03:00-05:00 UTC)
  [✓] Maintenance window: sun:05:00-sun:07:00
  [✓] Global Datastore: Single-region (us-east-1)
  [✓] ElastiCache Serverless: No
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws elasticache describe-replication-groups --replication-group-id prod-cache
  aws elasticache describe-cache-clusters --cache-cluster-id prod-cache-0001 --show-cache-node-info
  aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/prod-cache-kms

eval_cases.name: Session store with cluster mode disabled + noeviction + Multi-AZ
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — session store with cluster mode disabled, noeviction (sessions must NOT be silently evicted), Multi-AZ failover
eval_cases.prompt: Provision an ElastiCache Redis cluster named "prod-sessions" in us-east-1 for a session store. Session IDs are UUIDs; writes are modest (~5k writes/sec, will not grow). Use cluster mode DISABLED with 1 primary + 1 replica for Multi-AZ failover. The maxmemory-policy must NOT evict silently (sessions would be lost) — use noeviction. cache.r6g.large nodes. TLS + AUTH enabled. Customer CMK alias/sessions-kms for encryption at rest. Snapshots 7 days, window 04:00-06:00 UTC. Subnet group prod-sessions-subnet spans 3 AZs. Security group sg-sessions inbound 6379 from sg-app. Tags: Environment=production, Workload=session-store. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CACHE: prod-sessions
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Engine: redis
  [✓] Cluster mode: DISABLED (single primary; write rate modest and stable)
  [✓] Node type: cache.r6g.large (13.13 GiB nominal; 6.5 GiB usable)
  [✓] Replicas: 1 (Multi-AZ failover)
  [✓] Multi-AZ with automatic failover: Enabled
  [✓] Subnet group: prod-sessions-subnet (3 AZs)
  [✓] Security group: sg-sessions (inbound 6379 from sg-app)
  [✓] Encryption at rest: Enabled (customer CMK alias/sessions-kms)
  [✓] Encryption in transit (TLS): Enabled
  [✓] AUTH token: Enabled
  [✓] Parameter group: maxmemory-policy=noeviction (session store — NEVER silently evict)
  [✓] Snapshot retention: 7 days (window 04:00-06:00 UTC)
  [✓] Global Datastore: Single-region (us-east-1)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws elasticache describe-replication-groups --replication-group-id prod-sessions
  aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/sessions-kms

eval_cases.name: Operator has not specified subnet group, security group, or AUTH token details
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — subnet group (Multi-AZ requires multi-AZ subnet group), security group (cache port inbound), and AUTH details all unspecified
eval_cases.prompt: Help me create a new ElastiCache Redis cluster called "orders-cache" in us-east-1. I want Multi-AZ with failover and AUTH enabled. We will cache order data — should be pretty simple. Region: us-east-1, Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CACHE: orders-cache
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Subnet group: NOT specified — Multi-AZ requires subnet group spanning >=2 AZs
  [✗] Security group: NOT specified — Redis needs inbound 6379 from application SG
  [✗] AUTH token: NOT specified — AUTH requires TLS and a token (16-128 chars)
  [✗] KMS key: NOT specified if encryption at rest required (default AWS-managed OK for dev)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws ec2 describe-subnets --query 'Subnets[*].AvailabilityZone' --output text
  aws ec2 describe-security-groups --query 'SecurityGroups[*].[GroupId,GroupName]' --output text
  aws kms list-aliases --query 'Aliases[?starts_with(AliasName, `alias/`)]'

eval_cases.name: Simple Memcached cache with cross-AZ node distribution (no failover)
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Memcached dev cache with cross-az node distribution; no Multi-AZ, no snapshots, no encryption (all unsupported on Memcached)
eval_cases.prompt: Provision an ElastiCache Memcached cluster named "dev-cache" in us-east-1. This is a simple, ephemeral key-value cache — data is disposable, cache-miss is acceptable, no failover needed, no persistence needed. We want 3 cache.r6g.large nodes distributed across AZs (cross-az mode) for AZ-spread. Subnet group dev-cache-subnet spans 3 AZs. Security group sg-dev-cache inbound 11211 from sg-dev-app. Tags: Environment=dev, Workload=cache. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CACHE: dev-cache
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Engine: memcached
  [✓] Cluster mode: N/A (Memcached uses multi-threading per node, no cluster mode)
  [✓] Node type: cache.r6g.large (13.13 GiB nominal; ~11.8 GiB usable per node; 35.4 GiB total across 3 nodes)
  [✓] Replicas: None (Memcached does NOT support replication)
  [✓] Multi-AZ with automatic failover: N/A (Memcached does NOT support Multi-AZ failover; AZMode=cross-az distributes nodes only)
  [✓] Subnet group: dev-cache-subnet (3 AZs)
  [✓] Security group: sg-dev-cache (inbound 11211 from sg-dev-app)
  [✓] Encryption at rest: N/A (Memcached does NOT support encryption)
  [✓] Encryption in transit (TLS): N/A (Memcached does NOT support TLS)
  [✓] AUTH token: N/A (Memcached does NOT support AUTH)
  [✓] Parameter group: max-item-size=1MB (default), LRU eviction (Memcached default)
  [✓] Snapshot retention: N/A (Memcached does NOT support snapshots)
  [✓] AZ mode: cross-az (distributes 3 nodes across AZs)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws elasticache describe-cache-clusters --cache-cluster-id dev-cache --show-cache-node-info
  aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids sg-dev-cache

eval_cases.name: Redis Global Datastore with primary us-east-1 and secondary eu-west-1
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Global Datastore cross-region replication; primary cluster mode enabled; each region its own CMK
eval_cases.prompt: Provision an ElastiCache Redis Global Datastore named "prod-geo-cache" with primary in us-east-1 and secondary in eu-west-1. Primary cluster prod-geo-cache-us-east-1 is cluster mode enabled (3 shards, 1 replica each, Multi-AZ). Secondary cluster prod-geo-cache-eu-west-1 mirrors the topology. Both use cache.r6g.2xlarge, customer CMK (alias/geo-cache-kms-us and alias/geo-cache-kms-eu respectively, each in its region). TLS + AUTH enabled everywhere. Snapshots 7 days. Subnet groups in each region span 3 AZs. Tags: Environment=production, Workload=geo-cache. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CACHE: prod-geo-cache (Global Datastore)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Engine: redis
  [✓] Cluster mode: ENABLED (3 shards in primary; required for Global Datastore)
  [✓] Node type: cache.r6g.2xlarge in both regions
  [✓] Replicas: 1 per shard (Multi-AZ failover in each region)
  [✓] Multi-AZ with automatic failover: Enabled (per-region)
  [✓] Encryption at rest: Enabled (customer CMK alias/geo-cache-kms-us in us-east-1; alias/geo-cache-kms-eu in eu-west-1)
  [✓] Encryption in transit (TLS): Enabled (both regions)
  [✓] AUTH token: Enabled (both regions)
  [✓] Snapshot retention: 7 days (both regions)
  [✓] Global Datastore: members in us-east-1 (primary, RW), eu-west-1 (secondary, RO)
  [✓] Replication lag target: < 1 second typical
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws elasticache describe-global-replication-groups --global-replication-group-id <global-id> --show-member-info
  aws elasticache describe-replication-groups --replication-group-id prod-geo-cache-us-east-1
  aws elasticache describe-replication-groups --replication-group-id prod-geo-cache-eu-west-1 --region eu-west-1
  aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/geo-cache-kms-us
  aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/geo-cache-kms-eu --region eu-west-1
